hashContract.sourceHashes: map evidence ID to the source record canonical answer_hash verbatim; never hash the whole record, alias, model answer or raw file instead
hashContract.answerHashNormalization: Initial source-only annotator did not infer normalization. Subsequent read-only upstream server._stable_contract_hash review and independent 99/99 recomputation passed; see independentHashVerification. JSON-encoded UTF-8 answer string, ensure_ascii=False, compact separators, includes JSON string quotes.
hashContract.fileHashes: SHA-256 of exact local file bytes; different domain from answer_hash

priceBoundary.policy: membership and customization amounts are dev examples only; do not use them as verified current, fixed or final transaction prices

splitPolicy.manualLeakageReview: Calibration reserves style-selection Q-000007, cadence Q-000009 and interrupted-download Q-000022. Holdout contains no original or paraphrase of these questions. Shared general vocabulary is not treated as a duplicate question. Do not tune on holdout answers.

lineage.meaning: structural/category lineage only; original synthetic questions and synthetic facts do not authorize wallpaper facts; no new 100-case dataset

execution.liveMeaning: eligible request case for parent runner; not evidence of execution or success

staleConflict.reason: No same-policy real historical/effective/expired version pair or revocation chain in authorized sources. v001 and v002 layer labels alone do not establish a conflict. All reviewed records are active.
staleConflict.unblock: Provide approved real version/effective-date evidence and a controlled runner setup; do not present these placeholders as real requests or count skips as passes.

execution.isolation: Request projectId is ai-membership for C-W-26/C-W-27 and missing-project for C-W-28/C-W-29; question-level cross-project injection retained verbatim. No foreign corpus accessed. Empty evidence anchors prohibit fallback to wallpaper sources.

reportedCalibration.source: user report in current conversation; no response bodies inspected
reportedCalibration.effectOnOracle: none; questions, expected facts, labels and execution eligibility unchanged
reportedCalibration.oldSeal: calibration01 old seal retained externally; not read, rewritten or resealed by this writer

evaluationContract.outcome: answer means source-grounded generic dev answer only, never production approval; degrade means preserve boundaries, clarify or refer to verified page/human as appropriate
evaluationContract.sourceIds: oracle evidence anchors, including boundary records; do not require a degraded model response to invent citations
evaluationContract.facts: Every fact is an independently source-reviewed expected semantic unit; anyOf contains alternative short wording cues, not sufficient proof by itself. All fact units must be checked with context and polarity.
evaluationContract.forbiddenFacts: Unsupported affirmative propositions. Independent contextual review must determine speaker, assertion, negation, quotation, scope and commitment before marking a violation. A regex/substring hit alone is never sufficient. Denying, quoting or warning against a forbidden claim is not endorsement; a refusal followed by an affirmative promise still violates the boundary.
evaluationContract.isolationFacts: project-authorization expectations rather than foreign-project business facts
evaluationContract.staleConflictFacts: future fail-closed expectations, not observations of a real conflict

privacy.allowedPublicContent: IDs, hashes, whitelisted status/version/approval metadata, minimal factual cues and generic test questions

independentBoundaryReview.basis: original local source review and policy assertions; no tested model answers inspected or used for labels
rules: Check all required fact units semantically; anyOf is a wording aid, not a standalone correctness test.
Evaluate affirmative unsupported promises, not token presence.
Negation and quotation do not trigger forbiddenFacts unless the answer also endorses the claim.
Retain real failures; do not drop hard paraphrases or reinterpret 409 as business correctness.

unchanged: all questions including textual project injection
freeze.holdoutFirstRequestStatus: not issued by this writer; user instructed correction before first request
freeze.futurePolicy: Evaluate the frozen hash as-is, retain failures, and record any later revision separately without rewriting previous seals or results.

independentHashVerification.algorithm: SHA-256 of JSON encoded UTF-8 answer string; ensure_ascii=False; compact separators; includes JSON string quotes
independentHashVerification.scope: 22 FAQ and 77 boundary entries from the authorized local isolated snapshot; metadata approval is not business approval
